summary: Faz 9 CP4.23 — Task-Category Visibility + Employee↔Manager Assignment. Verified backend E2E flow (default hidden → user-grant visible → company-grant visible → full-revoke hidden → scope=manage still full admin view) with a new pytest suite (5/5 green). Frontend UI: 16/16 checks green — İş Kolları purple Lock button opens visibility modal with 25 company checkboxes + 24 user checkboxes, save produces toast + '+1 paylaşım' badge next to category; KULLANICILAR briefcase (admin-managers-<username>) opens manager-assign-modal with 5 manager/admin checkboxes for ahmet; save closes modal cleanly. critical_code_review_comments: tasks_router.py:325-336 scope=my_tasks builds $or of {company_id}, {visible_to_company_ids}, {visible_to_user_ids} — correct 3-way visibility; short-circuit returns [] when caller has no company_id AND no uid (defensive).
TaskCategoriesManagement.jsx already uses taskCategoriesApi.list('manage') and TasksPanel.jsx uses 'my_tasks' — verified via 200 responses, no crash, categories render in both places.
UserManagement briefcase modal correctly filters candidates to role in {manager, admin} — ahmet's modal shows 5 (serkan, mgr_test + 3 mgrDS_*) with data-testid mgr-assign-checkbox-<username>.

Minor: `test_task_categories.py` and `test_multi_company.py` fail under xdist parallel runners because single-session rule kicks parallel logins (SESSION_KICKED 401). Not a regression from this feature — same behaviour exists for any parallel auth test. Consider `pytest --dist loadfile` or serial fixtures for auth-heavy suites. Main agent's earlier '40/40 green' run was likely serial.
